title: Je mesbais de vous (Busnoys)
desc: Antoine Busnoys, Je mesbais de vous. 3 voices (Discantus, Tenor, Contra), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Bus3028); encoded by Jesse Rodin.
